notes.title: Linux version of Ultimate Racing 2D now available!
notes.content:
The Linux version of Ultimate Racing 2D is now available with the same features as the Windows/Mac version and with Crossplatform Online multiplayer between Linux/Mac/Windows players.

Features:
[list]
[*] 35 racing classes
[*] 300+ different cars
[*] 45+ tracks
[*] Online multiplayer up to 20 players
[*] Local multiplayer up to 8 players
[*] Career mode, Championship mode and Quick Race mode
[/list]


Note:
You may need to install the following dependencies if the game doesn't start:

libcurl4
libopenal1

notes.title: Career and Tyre Improvements - Patch 1.0.4.1 Released!
notes.content:
*Event mode can now be played in 2 ways:
-Mode 1: buy cars with the coins you earn (like the old career mode).
-Mode 2: use a fixed car.
*Some cars are cheaper in coin mode.
*Oval cars have higher top speed (Formula Speedway, Stock Car and Speedway Truck).
*Tyre improvements:
-AI's tyres last less long and AI goes to pit earlier.
-Tyre bar gives better representation of the tyre state.
-Soft/Hard tyres have more grip at low wet level, and wet tyres have more grip and speed at dry track.
-Track gets wet/dry less fast.
*10% rain option added.
*AI makes better use of its power boost.
*Bugs fixed.

notes.title: New Game Modes and more- Patch 1.0.3.9 Released!
notes.content:
New Game Modes:
*Event mode (fixed career events with objective)
*Season mode (race 10 seasons, get contract offers based on your result)
*Coin mode (earn coins to buy your way to Formula A)

More:
*One difficulty setting, which can be set from 0 (very easy) to 120 (ultimate)
*Blue flag for lapped AI cars
*AI race paths improved (faster cornering and lower AI top speed)
*More AI overtakes
*Slipstream increased
*Achievements page with season results
*Option to change career name
*AI grass/gravel damping increased
*Wet tyres grip in rain increased
*AI stuck in pit lane bug fixed
